- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo, defaults to 10m) - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- claude-api: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.

48		conf := &oauth2.Config{
49			ClientID:     p.config.ClientId,

19	func (s *APIV1Service) resolveSSOUser(ctx context.Context, currentUser *store.User, identityProvider *storepb.IdentityProvider, userInfo *idp.IdentityProviderUserInfo) (*store.User, error) {
20		provider := identityProvider.Uid
21		externUID := userInfo.Identifier
22	
23		user, err := s.getLinkedSSOUser(ctx, provider, externUID)
24		if err != nil {
25			return nil, err
26		}
27		if user != nil {
28			if currentUser != nil && currentUser.ID != user.ID {
29				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.AlreadyExists, "identity provider account is already linked to another user")
30			}
31			return user, nil
32		}
33	
34		if currentUser != nil {
35			return s.bindSSOIdentityToUser(ctx, currentUser, provider, externUID)
36		}
37	
38		// Miss path: enforce the registration gate before creating anything.
39		instanceGeneralSetting, err := s.Store.GetInstanceGeneralSetting(ctx)
40		if err != nil {
41			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get instance general setting, error: %v", err)
42		}
43		if instanceGeneralSetting.DisallowUserRegistration {
44			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "user registration is not allowed")
45		}
46	
47		password, err := util.RandomString(20)
48		if err != nil {
49			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to generate random password, error: %v", err)
50		}
51		passwordHash, err := bcrypt.GenerateFromPassword([]byte(password), bcrypt.DefaultCost)
52		if err != nil {
53			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to generate password hash, error: %v", err)
54		}
55		username, err := deriveSSOUsername()
56		if err != nil {
57			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to derive username, error: %v", err)
58		}
59		user, err = s.Store.CreateUser(ctx, &store.User{
60			Username:     username,
61			Role:         store.RoleUser,
62			Nickname:     userInfo.DisplayName,
63			Email:        userInfo.Email,
64			AvatarURL:    userInfo.AvatarURL,
65			PasswordHash: string(passwordHash),
66		})
67		if err != nil {
68			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create user, error: %v", err)
69		}
70	
71		if _, err := s.Store.CreateUserIdentity(ctx, &store.UserIdentity{
72			UserID:    user.ID,
73			Provider:  provider,
74			ExternUID: externUID,
75		}); err != nil {
76			// Best-effort cleanup: the provisional user row has no linkage and should not remain.
77			_, _ = s.Store.DeleteUser(ctx, &store.DeleteUser{ID: user.ID})
78			if isUniqueConstraintViolation(err) {
79				// Concurrent first login won the race; load the winning linkage's user.
80				winner, getErr := s.Store.GetUserIdentity(ctx, &store.FindUserIdentity{
81					Provider:  &provider,
82					ExternUID: &externUID,
83				})
84				if getErr != nil {
85					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to reload user identity after race, error: %v", getErr)
86				}
87				if winner == nil {
88					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "user identity conflict reported but no winning row found")
89				}
90				winnerUser, getErr := s.Store.GetUser(ctx, &store.FindUser{ID: &winner.UserID})
91				if getErr != nil {
92					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user after race, error: %v", getErr)
93				}
94				if winnerUser == nil {
95					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "linked user %d not found after race", winner.UserID)
96				}
97				return winnerUser, nil
98			}
99			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create user identity, error: %v", err)
100		}
101		return user, nil
102	}

104	func (s *APIV1Service) resolveSSOIdentity(ctx context.Context, idpName, code, redirectURI, codeVerifier string) (*storepb.IdentityProvider, *idp.IdentityProviderUserInfo, error) {
105		idpUID, err := ExtractIdentityProviderUIDFromName(idpName)
106		if err != nil {
107			return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid identity provider name: %v", err)
108		}
109		identityProvider, err := s.Store.GetIdentityProvider(ctx, &store.FindIdentityProvider{
110			UID: &idpUID,
111		})
112		if err != nil {
113			return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get identity provider, error: %v", err)
114		}
115		if identityProvider == nil {
116			return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "identity provider not found")
117		}
118	
119		var userInfo *idp.IdentityProviderUserInfo
120		if identityProvider.Type == storepb.IdentityProvider_OAUTH2 {
121			oauth2IdentityProvider, err := oauth2.NewIdentityProvider(identityProvider.Config.GetOauth2Config())
122			if err != nil {
123				return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create oauth2 identity provider, error: %v", err)
124			}
125			// Pass code_verifier for PKCE support (empty string if not provided for backward compatibility)
126			token, err := oauth2IdentityProvider.ExchangeToken(ctx, redirectURI, code, codeVerifier)
127			if err != nil {
128				return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to exchange token, error: %v", err)
129			}
130			userInfo, err = oauth2IdentityProvider.UserInfo(ctx, token)
131			if err != nil {
132				return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user info, error: %v", err)
133			}
134		}
135	
136		identifierFilter := identityProvider.IdentifierFilter
137		if identifierFilter != "" {
138			identifierFilterRegex, err := regexp.Compile(identifierFilter)
139			if err != nil {
140				return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to compile identifier filter regex, error: %v", err)

77	func newMockServer(t *testing.T, code, accessToken string, userinfo []byte) *httptest.Server {
78		mux := http.NewServeMux()
79	
80		var rawIDToken string
81		mux.HandleFunc("/oauth2/token", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
82			require.Equal(t, http.MethodPost, r.Method)
83	
84			body, err := io.ReadAll(r.Body)
85			require.NoError(t, err)
86			vals, err := url.ParseQuery(string(body))
87			require.NoError(t, err)
88	
89			require.Equal(t, code, vals.Get("code"))
90			require.Equal(t, "authorization_code", vals.Get("grant_type"))
91	
92			w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
93			err = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{
94				"access_token": accessToken,
95				"token_type":   "Bearer",
96				"expires_in":   3600,
97				"id_token":     rawIDToken,
98			})
99			require.NoError(t, err)
100		})
101		mux.HandleFunc("/oauth2/userinfo", func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
102			w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
103			_, err := w.Write(userinfo)
104			require.NoError(t, err)
105		})
106	
107		s := httptest.NewServer(mux)
108	
109		return s
110	}

166	func TestIdentityProviderExchangeTokenClientAuthentication(t *testing.T) {
167		const (

169			clientSecret = "test-client-secret"
170			code         = "test-code"

183				expectedRequests: 1,
184			},

187				acceptBasicAuth:  false,
188				expectedRequests: 2,
189			},

192		for _, test := range tests {
193			t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
194				requestCount := 0
195				server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
196					requestCount++
197					require.NoError(t, r.ParseForm())
198					require.Equal(t, code, r.Form.Get("code"))
199					require.Equal(t, codeVerifier, r.Form.Get("code_verifier"))
200	
201					username, password, hasBasicAuth := r.BasicAuth()
202					if test.acceptBasicAuth {

204						require.Equal(t, clientID, username)

19	func (s *APIV1Service) resolveSSOUser(ctx context.Context, currentUser *store.User, identityProvider *storepb.IdentityProvider, userInfo *idp.IdentityProviderUserInfo) (*store.User, error) {
20		provider := identityProvider.Uid
21		externUID := userInfo.Identifier
22	
23		user, err := s.getLinkedSSOUser(ctx, provider, externUID)
24		if err != nil {
25			return nil, err
26		}
27		if user != nil {
28			if currentUser != nil && currentUser.ID != user.ID {
29				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.AlreadyExists, "identity provider account is already linked to another user")
30			}
31			return user, nil
32		}
33	
34		if currentUser != nil {
35			return s.bindSSOIdentityToUser(ctx, currentUser, provider, externUID)
36		}
37	
38		// Miss path: enforce the registration gate before creating anything.
39		instanceGeneralSetting, err := s.Store.GetInstanceGeneralSetting(ctx)
40		if err != nil {
41			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get instance general setting, error: %v", err)
42		}
43		if instanceGeneralSetting.DisallowUserRegistration {
44			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "user registration is not allowed")
45		}
46	
47		password, err := util.RandomString(20)
48		if err != nil {
49			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to generate random password, error: %v", err)
50		}
51		passwordHash, err := bcrypt.GenerateFromPassword([]byte(password), bcrypt.DefaultCost)
52		if err != nil {
53			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to generate password hash, error: %v", err)
54		}
55		username, err := deriveSSOUsername()
56		if err != nil {
57			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to derive username, error: %v", err)
58		}
59		user, err = s.Store.CreateUser(ctx, &store.User{
60			Username:     username,
61			Role:         store.RoleUser,
62			Nickname:     userInfo.DisplayName,
63			Email:        userInfo.Email,
64			AvatarURL:    userInfo.AvatarURL,
65			PasswordHash: string(passwordHash),
66		})
67		if err != nil {
68			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create user, error: %v", err)
69		}
70	
71		if _, err := s.Store.CreateUserIdentity(ctx, &store.UserIdentity{
72			UserID:    user.ID,
73			Provider:  provider,
74			ExternUID: externUID,
75		}); err != nil {
76			// Best-effort cleanup: the provisional user row has no linkage and should not remain.
77			_, _ = s.Store.DeleteUser(ctx, &store.DeleteUser{ID: user.ID})
78			if isUniqueConstraintViolation(err) {
79				// Concurrent first login won the race; load the winning linkage's user.
80				winner, getErr := s.Store.GetUserIdentity(ctx, &store.FindUserIdentity{
81					Provider:  &provider,
82					ExternUID: &externUID,
83				})
84				if getErr != nil {
85					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to reload user identity after race, error: %v", getErr)
86				}
87				if winner == nil {
88					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "user identity conflict reported but no winning row found")
89				}
90				winnerUser, getErr := s.Store.GetUser(ctx, &store.FindUser{ID: &winner.UserID})
91				if getErr != nil {
92					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user after race, error: %v", getErr)
93				}
94				if winnerUser == nil {
95					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "linked user %d not found after race", winner.UserID)
96				}
97				return winnerUser, nil
98			}
99			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create user identity, error: %v", err)
100		}
101		return user, nil
102	}

104	func (s *APIV1Service) resolveSSOIdentity(ctx context.Context, idpName, code, redirectURI, codeVerifier string) (*storepb.IdentityProvider, *idp.IdentityProviderUserInfo, error) {
105		idpUID, err := ExtractIdentityProviderUIDFromName(idpName)
106		if err != nil {
107			return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid identity provider name: %v", err)
108		}
109		identityProvider, err := s.Store.GetIdentityProvider(ctx, &store.FindIdentityProvider{
110			UID: &idpUID,
111		})
112		if err != nil {
113			return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get identity provider, error: %v", err)
114		}
115		if identityProvider == nil {
116			return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "identity provider not found")
117		}
118	
119		var userInfo *idp.IdentityProviderUserInfo
120		if identityProvider.Type == storepb.IdentityProvider_OAUTH2 {
121			oauth2IdentityProvider, err := oauth2.NewIdentityProvider(identityProvider.Config.GetOauth2Config())
122			if err != nil {
123				return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create oauth2 identity provider, error: %v", err)
124			}
125			// Pass code_verifier for PKCE support (empty string if not provided for backward compatibility)
126			token, err := oauth2IdentityProvider.ExchangeToken(ctx, redirectURI, code, codeVerifier)
127			if err != nil {
128				return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to exchange token, error: %v", err)
129			}
130			userInfo, err = oauth2IdentityProvider.UserInfo(ctx, token)
131			if err != nil {
132				return nil, nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user info, error: %v", err)
133			}
134		}
135

77	func newMockServer(t *testing.T, code, accessToken string, userinfo []byte) *httptest.Server {
78		mux := http.NewServeMux()
79	
80		var rawIDToken string
81		mux.HandleFunc("/oauth2/token", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
82			require.Equal(t, http.MethodPost, r.Method)
83	
84			body, err := io.ReadAll(r.Body)
85			require.NoError(t, err)
86			vals, err := url.ParseQuery(string(body))
87			require.NoError(t, err)
88	
89			require.Equal(t, code, vals.Get("code"))
90			require.Equal(t, "authorization_code", vals.Get("grant_type"))
91	
92			w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
93			err = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{
94				"access_token": accessToken,
95				"token_type":   "Bearer",
96				"expires_in":   3600,
97				"id_token":     rawIDToken,
98			})
99			require.NoError(t, err)
100		})
101		mux.HandleFunc("/oauth2/userinfo", func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
102			w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
103			_, err := w.Write(userinfo)
104			require.NoError(t, err)
105		})
106	
107		s := httptest.NewServer(mux)
108	
109		return s
110	}

166	func TestIdentityProviderExchangeTokenClientAuthentication(t *testing.T) {

193			t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
194				requestCount := 0
195				server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
196					requestCount++
197					require.NoError(t, r.ParseForm())
198					require.Equal(t, code, r.Form.Get("code"))
199					require.Equal(t, codeVerifier, r.Form.Get("code_verifier"))
200
